description:
## Goal

Make every started production job complete into the existing dependency ledger exactly once with one typed AttemptOutcome: Complete(publication), Blocked or Failed(diagnostic), plus its actual fact and product observations.

## Contract

Complete installs only a validated typed publication from fz-tfn.53 and replaces the attempt's observations and claims. Failed owns its immutable diagnostic and actual observations, withdraws that attempt's stale direct claims, and remains subscribed only to dependencies that can make correction relevant. Blocked retains only publications still independently justified by accepted immutable source.

A relevant movement wakes an attempt once. Repeating an unchanged failure or changing unrelated source performs no requested-root retry. Job identity and DependencyIndex remain the sole attempt, read, wait and output authority; diagnostics are outcomes, not a retry registry.

This ticket establishes direct attempt ownership. It does not claim to remove cyclic transitive copies; fz-kdt.64 owns supported semantic alternatives after this boundary.

## TDD

At production boundaries cover parse, scope, definition, macro, semantic, generated-lowering, product and runtime-demand failures after partial reads; prior success then failure; Blocked then Failed; shared roots; unchanged retry; unrelated edit; exact relevant correction; and FIFO, LIFO and permuted wakes. Include a successfully defined macro whose product fails semantically, is retired while still demanded, and succeeds exactly once after a relevant source correction. Do not use an unresolved callable that fz-tfn.62 correctly rejects before any macro product exists.

Every started job has exactly one applied completion. A failure preserves independently accepted source-prefix events, retires only its own claims, keeps exact diagnostics and observations, and publishes a later correction once.

A requester awaiting an unsubmitted provider records the exact missing ModuleInterface observation. Provider arrival wakes it once; unrelated arrival wakes nothing.

## Deletion and acceptance

Delete FatalError exits that bypass completion, ad hoc diagnostic flushing and ownership, failed-job maps, retry queues, reconstructed observations, invented producers, global scans and compatibility exits. Any direct semantic or runtime write remaining after fz-tfn.53 moves into completion here before the every-attempt claim is accepted. Full focused, causal, library, fixture, CLI, deterministic, documentation, formatting, check and strict-Clippy gates pass; fresh ticket-scoped cold review precedes one commit and close.
title: Complete every compiler attempt into the dependency ledger
